tweetText: OpenAI launched Lockdown Mode for ChatGPT to help protect sensitive data from prompt injection attacks. While not foolproof, it aims to reduce the chances of data leaks. via TechCrunch AI

Sriram Krishnan is stepping down as the White House AI advisor to launch a new institution focused on AI policy. His move could influence the future of AI regulations under Trump's vision. via TechCrunch AI

Trump's administration is considering taking an equity stake in OpenAI to ensure Americans benefit from AI's success. This could reshape how public and private interests align in the tech sector. via TechCrunch AI
Chinese peptide labs are booming thanks to crypto funding. This trend raises concerns about the intersection of finance, biotech, and security. via WIRED AI
Meta has launched a new AI feature that generates clickbait articles for its users. This raises concerns about misinformation and the quality of content on social media. via The Verge AI.

Apple is set to reintroduce a revamped Siri at WWDC 2024, after facing criticism for its previous AI rollout. This redesign could help Apple regain ground in the competitive AI landscape. via The Verge AI
